finding: J1 Phoenix MSTB 2,5/2-GF-5,08 (1776508) compared on 2026-10-15 with the Phoenix family drawing 00855760/06 (2 positions: a = 5.08, w = 20.27): pin pitch 5.08 mm, 1.4 mm pin drill and the body from 7.6 mm before pin 1 to 7.6 mm after pin 2 (20.27 mm) match the footprint. The drawing also shows two optional fastening holes of 2.4 mm diameter for ISO 1481-ST 2.2 x 6.5 screws, about 5.18 mm beyond the end pins and 2.5 mm from the pin row toward the body; the footprint has no such holes. Pad shape (2.08 x 3.6 mm) is a CAD choice: the drawing gives no land. The 12 A rating comes from the library description and is not shown on this drawing. Mating plug 1777989 (MSTB 2,5/2-STF-5,08), product drawing 01548445/00 of 2023-05-03: the sheet shows views at scale 1:1 without printed dimensions, so these values were measured on the drawing (about 0.3 mm uncertainty): overall width about 20.0 mm (header body 20.27 mm), height about 15.0 mm, depth about 18.2 mm, two flange screws about 15.5 mm apart, which agrees with the header's fastening positions (5.08 + 2 x 5.18 = 15.44 mm). On the board J1 is rotated 180 degrees with pins at (14.08, 12) and (9.0, 12) mm and its body front face at y = 2.0 mm, so the plug enters from the top edge and extends past it; the two optional fastening holes would fall at about (3.82, 9.5) and (19.26, 9.5) mm
remaining: Decide on adding the two 2.4 mm fastening holes and their screw clearance (the screwed plug pulls on the soldered pins otherwise); confirm the plug dimensions, the 12 A rating and the wire range with the Phoenix datasheet, since the supplied plug drawing carries no dimensions; physical fit not performed
